Increase the rate at which Skills can be used- both by reducing the duration of their animations and by reducing the time between successive uses.

skill Rate = (Base Animation Speed) x [ 1+(corresponding skill Speed)]

## Cast Speed[]

Cast Speed is one of the Character Stats which increases the rate at which Spell Skills can be used and Minions can be summoned by reducing the time it takes to complete the action, including the animation. Cast speed does not affect any cooldown time that may be imposed between casts of a skill.

The formula for Casts per second is:

{\displaystyle CastsPerSecond = BaseAnimationSpeed*(1+IncreasedCastSpeed-ReducedCastSpeed)}

### Instant Cast[]

Some skills grant the ability to be cast instantly. This allows the chraracter to continue one action (attacking or moving) without interruption while casting another skill. The effect of the skill are not always instantaneous and may require a very short period of time for the skill to become active.

Skills that are cast instantly are usually centered on the character and are able to move with the character.

### Cast Time[]

Cast time is the time in seconds that it takes to cast a spell. Cast Time is the inverse of Cast Speed; the greater the increase in Cast Speed, the shorter the Cast Time.

The formula for Cast Time is:

{\displaystyle CastTime =\frac{1}{CastsPerSecond}}

### Cooldown Time[]

Skills may impose a cooldown time between casts. The cooldown time is a minimum time between the end of a cast and the start of the next cast. Cooldown time is not affected by Cast Speed. The minimum time between casts is the cooldown time plus cast time.
